basic_info.description: Well-located in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Eureka/Noe Valley neighborhoods, this 1912 Arts and Crafts home offers a rare blend of historic charm and modern living. This lovingly maintained home features original wood built-ins, wainscoting paneling, box-beamed ceiling and a fireplace that all add warmth and character. The main level features living room, dining room, kitchen and half bath. There is a primary suite with full-bath & walk-in closet, 2 additional bedrooms and a full bath on the upper level to create the perfect balance of togetherness and retreat. There are 2 large skylights that flood this level with natural light. Step outside to a serene yard and deck, which  is a beautiful outdoor haven for barbecues, gardening, or playtime. Enjoy downtown views from the elevated deck, that is accessible by either the kitchen or the "bridge" from the primary suite. Just blocks away, enjoy the restaurants and shops of Noe Valley and the Castro or venture out to Mission Dolores Park, the playground and tennis courts at Eureka Valley Rec Center. The lower-level features laundry area, additional storage and an attached 1-car garage.
